documents.name: clauses.md
documents.text:
Clause 12.1 A berth change needs 14 days of written notice.
Notice v2.0 was posted on the harbour gate.
The posted fee is Rs. 480.
No. 4 is the night watch.
A delay, i.e. a late tide, is logged once.
Read clause 12.1.
The harbour master signs the slip.
Clause 4.2 The draft limit is 3.5 metres.
